local scn, done = ...
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local out = {}
local function rec(k, e) out[k] = { model = e:GetModel(), skin = e:GetSkin(), skins = e:SkinCount(), groups = e:GetNumBodyGroups(),
  bg = { e:GetBodygroup(0), e:GetBodygroup(1), e:GetBodygroup(2) }, counts = { e:GetBodygroupCount(0), e:GetBodygroupCount(1), e:GetBodygroupCount(2) } } end
-- the kleiner bot as spawned, then skins and body groups set the way GM:PlayerSetModel does from
-- cl_playerskin / cl_playerbodygroups (SetSkin / SetBodyGroups), in and out of range
rec("spawned", bot)
bot:SetSkin(1) rec("skin1", bot)
bot:SetSkin(7) rec("skin7", bot)
bot:SetSkin(-1) rec("skin_neg", bot)
bot:SetSkin(0)
bot:SetBodyGroups("1") rec("bg_1", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("09") rec("bg_09", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("x1") rec("bg_x1", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("") rec("bg_empty", bot)
-- a model with real choices: the refugee set (hands 0100000) and a combine soldier
bot:SetModel("models/player/group03/male_01.mdl") rec("male01_fresh", bot)
bot:SetSkin(1) rec("male01_skin1", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("01") rec("male01_bg01", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("00") bot:SetSkin(3) rec("male01_skin3", bot)
bot:SetModel("models/player/combine_soldier.mdl") rec("combine_fresh", bot)
bot:SetSkin(1) rec("combine_skin1", bot)
bot:SetBodyGroups("1") rec("combine_bg1", bot)
-- does a respawn keep them? (the gamemode re-applies cl_* on PlayerSetModel; a bot has none)
local t = 0
hook.Add("Think", "parity_skin", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 1 then bot:Kill() end
  if t == 400 then
    hook.Remove("Think", "parity_skin")
    rec("respawned", bot)
    out.info = { skin_cvar = GetConVar("cl_playerskin") ~= nil, bg_cvar = GetConVar("cl_playerbodygroups") ~= nil,
      info_skin = bot:GetInfoNum("cl_playerskin", -5), info_bg = bot:GetInfo("cl_playerbodygroups") }
    done(out)
  end
end)
return "async"
